results.title: Laos Turns to Community Support as Young People Face Rising Mental Health Pressures
results.content: Mental health challenges often go unnoticed in Laos, where people experiencing anxiety and emotional distress may seek help for physical symptoms instead. Stigma, cultural beliefs, and a shortage of specialists make it harder for locals to get the care they need.
